channel.title: Coca-Cola Global Pulse
channel.description: Real-time updates from Coca-Cola facilities worldwide

item.title: Dallas Site: Best Practice Uploaded - 'Forklift Charging Safety'
item.description: The Dallas distribution center has shared a new safety protocol for forklift battery charging procedures. This best practice has reduced safety incidents by 35% in Q4 2025.
item.author: Dallas Operations Team

item.title: Atlanta HQ: Sustainability Milestone - 1 Million Bottles Recycled
item.description: Atlanta headquarters celebrates reaching 1 million recycled bottles through our employee recycling program. The initiative has diverted 15 tons of plastic from landfills.
item.author: Atlanta Sustainability Team

item.title: Shanghai Plant: Production Record - 500K Units in 24 Hours
item.description: The Shanghai bottling facility has set a new production record, producing 500,000 units in a single 24-hour period. Congratulations to the entire production team!
item.author: Shanghai Operations

item.title: London Distribution: New Electric Fleet Deployment Complete
item.description: London distribution center has successfully transitioned to 100% electric delivery vehicles. The new fleet reduces carbon emissions by 2,500 tons annually.
item.author: London Fleet Management

item.title: Mexico City: Employee Recognition - Team of the Quarter Announced
item.description: Congratulations to the Mexico City quality assurance team for being named Team of the Quarter. Their innovative testing procedures have improved product consistency by 18%.
item.author: Mexico City HR

item.title: Sydney Warehouse: Safety Training Update - New VR Modules Available
item.description: Sydney warehouse has launched new virtual reality safety training modules. All employees can now access immersive forklift operation and emergency response training.
item.author: Sydney Safety Division

item.title: Toronto Facility: Equipment Upgrade - New Automated Palletizer Installed
item.description: Toronto facility has completed installation of state-of-the-art automated palletizing equipment. Expected to increase efficiency by 40% while reducing workplace injuries.
item.author: Toronto Engineering

item.title: São Paulo Plant: Community Outreach - 5000 Students Visited This Year
item.description: São Paulo bottling plant reached a milestone of hosting 5,000 local students for educational facility tours in 2025. The program promotes STEM education and sustainability.
item.author: São Paulo Community Relations

item.title: Berlin Site: Innovation Lab - New Flavor Testing Results Shared
item.description: Berlin innovation lab has completed regional flavor preference testing. Results now available in the product development portal for Q2 2026 planning.
item.author: Berlin R&D Team

item.title: Mumbai Warehouse: Inventory Management Best Practice Uploaded
item.description: Mumbai warehouse shares their optimized inventory rotation system that reduced waste by 22%. Template and procedures now available for all sites to implement.
item.author: Mumbai Logistics

item.title: Chicago Distribution: Winter Weather Preparedness Checklist Released
item.description: Chicago distribution center has published a comprehensive winter weather preparedness checklist. All northern region sites are encouraged to review and implement these protocols.
item.author: Chicago Operations

item.title: Tokyo Headquarters: Digital Transformation Update - Mobile App Rollout
item.description: Tokyo HQ announces the global rollout of the new employee mobile app. Features include real-time production dashboards, shift management, and instant messaging.
item.author: Tokyo IT Division

item.title: Phoenix Facility: Energy Efficiency - Solar Panel Installation Complete
item.description: Phoenix facility completes installation of 2,000 solar panels on warehouse roof. Expected to provide 60% of the facility's energy needs and save $200K annually.
item.author: Phoenix Facilities Management

item.title: Paris Distribution: Customer Service Excellence Award Received
item.description: Paris distribution team receives European Customer Service Excellence Award for maintaining 99.8% on-time delivery rate throughout 2025. Outstanding work team!
item.author: Paris Customer Service
